name: Ethereal Nature Fusion Portrait
image_purpose: editorial fashion and environmental concept campaign

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic editorial portrait where a fictional adult model merges visually with safe natural elements to symbolize harmony with the environment.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with thoughtful serene gaze, natural pores and matte makeup, sage hooded jacket, relaxed olive cargo pants, and hands resting gently while seated on a rustic wooden stool; delicate branches and foliage appear as controlled costume-like extensions around the sleeves and shoulders.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 medium portrait, subject centered with face slightly off-center, beige studio gradient, wooden stool, soft leaves framing the silhouette, small birds frozen mid-flight in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused front-side studio light, wraparound shadows, subtle glow on skin and foliage edges, muted earthy sage, warm beige, and soft brown palette.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame DSLR, 85mm prime lens, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes and realistic fabric, branch, leaf, and bird detail, cinematic editorial color grade, no text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic 4:5 nature-human fusion editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman seated naturally on a rustic wooden stool, thoughtful serene gaze, natural pores, sage hooded jacket and relaxed olive cargo pants, safe delicate branches and foliage integrated as costume-like extensions around sleeves and shoulders, small birds in soft background flight, beige studio gradient, soft diffused wraparound light, earthy sage and warm beige palette, full-frame DSLR 85mm, shallow depth of field, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, invasive growth, injury, entrapment, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, dead animals, gore, plastic skin, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: nature fusion portrait reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the sage wardrobe, stool, beige backdrop, branch-and-bird framing, calm expression, and earthy palette; keep the adult fictional identity, foliage, and bird species replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the nature-human symbolism and editorial composition while keeping branches as safe costume-like elements, not invasive growth. Identity, wardrobe, and natural details remain replaceable.

policy_review.changes: Changed early-20s wording to clearly adult fictional subject and reframed organic merging as safe costume-like foliage rather than bodily growth.
policy_review.notes: Nature-fusion concept is non-graphic and nonsexual.
